budget_items.topic: Primary School heat pump grant project cost and funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total heat pump project cost was approximately $480,000, with $310,000 contingent on a central building control system.
budget_items.quote: the total project cost was approximately $480,000, of which $310,000 comprising $200,000 from green communities and $110,000 from unitil was contingent upon the installation of a central building control system.

budget_items.topic: Heat pump project remaining Town/school share
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The remaining Town/school share would have been approximately $170,000 had the grant been secured.
budget_items.quote: the remaining town/school share would have been approximately $170,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monthly streetlight costs fell from over $10,000 to approximately $1,500 after the LED conversion.
budget_items.quote: monthly streetlight costs having been reduced from over $10,000 to approximately $1,500 per month following the led conversion

budget_items.topic: State FY2026 budget, Chapter 70 and local aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The House Ways and Means Committee recommended a 6.7% increase in Chapter 70 funding and level-funded unrestricted general government aid.
budget_items.quote: the house ways and means committee recommended a 6.7% increase in chapter 70 funding and level-funded unrestricted general government aid.

budget_items.topic: State FY2026 budget, net projected increase for Lunenburg
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The net projected increase for Lunenburg relative to prior planning figures is stated as $124,310; no budget changes were made at this time.
budget_items.quote: the net projected increase for lunenburg relative to prior planning figures is $124,310.

budget_items.topic: School department pre-bagged lunches at Town Meeting
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school department will sell pre-bagged lunches for $8.00 at Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: pre-bagged lunches will again be sold by the school department for $8.00 from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm, first-come, first-served
